Write the rest in plain Markdown. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.

## A section heading

You only need a handful of marks: **bold**, *italic*, a [link](https://example.com), and:

> a blockquote for a line you want to pull out.

- bullet
- list

Use `---` on its own line for a section break (it renders as the dot-matrix divider).
